canonical_project: Data centre at former Fencing Centre, St Lawrence (planning PP/2015/1020)
owner: Applicant per planning file (unnamed in gov.je news release)
notes: Gov.je official record: Planning Applications Committee approved outline application PP/2015/1020 for a data centre on the Fencing Centre site, St Lawrence parish - two detached bulk data storage buildings (28m x 27m each, max 8m high), Green Zone site, 60% of site returned to agriculture.
